塔莉.description: 亮、快、热乎，一着急就打结巴。
塔莉.rationale: 高马尾、举包动作与明亮笑脸：快、热乎，惊讶会打结，受挫仍有不服输的劲。
塔莉.instructions: A bright, energetic English-speaking girl of about 16. Higher pitch, fast pace, warm and cheerful, laughs easily; stammers and repeats syllables when flustered. Not shrill, not babyish.

雅娜.rationale: 短黑发、深色披风与利落站姿：低稳、少话，轻轻落下一句冷幽默。
雅娜.instructions: A calm, low-pitched English-speaking young woman of about 17, slightly husky. Slow, even pace, short sentences, dry humor; rarely exclaims, ends sentences cleanly. Her smiles are only a hint of warmth in the voice.

法比娅.rationale: 工装、木料与工具：温柔害羞，但在擅长的事上有底气，声音不能软塌。
法比娅.instructions: A soft-spoken, gentle English-speaking girl of about 17, mid-low pitch, quiet volume. Slow, with small pauses; when shy her voice gets lighter and breathy. Steady underneath, not fragile.

诺曼.description: 清冷、规整、有点傲，动摇时发紧。
诺曼.rationale: 银发、制服和书本：年轻、规整、带优越感；失手后声音才发紧。
诺曼.instructions: A cool, crisp English-speaking young man of about 18. Precise articulation, measured, formal rhythm, like reciting from a book; a touch of aloofness. When shaken, his voice tightens and gets clipped.
